page_title: MDVR series LED light status definition
page_content:
### Introduction
This section describes the LED status indicators for our company's vehicle-mounted MDVR series devices; although the physical locations of the LEDs may vary, the meaning of each LED's status remains the same.

##### Status Indicators:
| Indicator | Solid On | Flashing | Off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PWR (Power) | Powered on; camera video normal | Powered on; video lost (camera disconnected, missing, or configuration mismatch) | N/A |
| GPS (Positioning) | Positioning successful | Module present; positioning unsuccessful | Module missing or faulty |
| REC (Recording) | HDD/Card present; not recording | HDD/Card present; recording in progress | HDD/Card not detected |
| NET (Network) | Registered on TTX private platform | Not registered on TTX private platform  |4G and Wi-Fi module malfunction|
